title.narrative: Support teachers’ development to improve learning outcomes in Nigeria

description.narrative: Teachers remain key factors for the attainment of quality education and one of the means of achieving SDG4. In 2023, teachers’ professional development was prioritized by providing support to TRCN for the hosting of Annual Conference of Registered Teachers and the operationalization of the already developed career path policy for teachers. Within the framework of the GPE Anglophone and the UNESCO-ECOWAS initiative, capacities of teachers were strengthened on the utilization of technology for teaching and learning with over 5000 completing self-paced courses on the imagine learning Africa platform. As the need to digitality transform teaching and enhance the profession across various thematic, UNESCO is positioned to support Nigeria within the 42 C5 to build on the gains already attained and set new agenda to transform teaching through policy support, teachers’ capacity strengthening, building of community of practice, curriculum transformation and leveraging technology for improved teaching and learning outcomes.
